ask.query: Which organizations partner on Project Phoenix and who leads it?
ask.answer: Project Phoenix is a quantum computing initiative led by Dr. Elena Vasilescu at the National Institute of Informatics in Bucharest. The project partners with CERN and the University of Bucharest to build a 128-qubit superconducting processor.
ask.retrieval_note: the graph leg did not contribute: retrieval.stages.graph.status was 'not_run' in the reproduction, so the answer came from the dense leg only. This record shows graph extraction and persistence, not graph-assisted retrieval.

delete_purge.entities_note: the delete tombstones an entity only when the deleted document was its only source. In this workspace a second document (03f42d1d...) was uploaded afterwards and the 12 entities are still linked to it, so they are active today. The mechanism was reproduced on a fresh single-document workspace: 7 entities, 6 relationships and 1 community were all tombstoned with empty document and chunk links.
